acceptance: Authorization is repeated immediately before the effect against the admitted environment, source statuses that are not authoritative are not taken as proof of no effect, the journal survives a torn tail and oversized details, and the browser presses only usable controls.

positive.fixture: write whose session lapses during the source read never reaches the source

negative.fixture: non-authoritative status, unproven throttle, torn journal tail, oversized detail, hidden, disabled and covered submit control

versions.schema: IR 1.1.0 unchanged; journal metadata optional keys added

security_and_source_permissions: No source effect after the session, caller or environment changed since admission.
known_limitations: Field values are still set by script events; only the submit press is a trusted input event
